#include <libproc.h>
#include <malloc/malloc.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <unistd.h>
static _Thread_local int inside;
static int sampled_rusage(int pid, int flavor, rusage_info_t *buffer) {
 static int (*original)(int,int,rusage_info_t *);
 if(!original) original=dlsym(RTLD_NEXT,"proc_pid_rusage");
 int result=original(pid,flavor,buffer);
 if(result==0 && pid==getpid() && !inside && (flavor==4 || flavor==6)) {
  struct rusage_info_v0 *info=(void *)buffer;
  if(info->ri_phys_footprint>1500000000ULL) {
   inside=1;
   unsigned long long before=info->ri_phys_footprint;
   size_t released=malloc_zone_pressure_relief(NULL,0);
   result=original(pid,flavor,buffer);
   if(released) fprintf(stderr,"malloc-relief-probe pid=%d released=%zu footprint_before=%llu footprint_after=%llu\n",pid,released,before,info->ri_phys_footprint);
   inside=0;
  }
 }
 return result;
}
__attribute__((used)) static struct { const void *replacement; const void *replacee; } interpose __attribute__((section("__DATA,__interpose"))) = {sampled_rusage,proc_pid_rusage};
